entries.title: Heroes of Newerth
entries.definitive_edition: Project KONGOR for classic preservation, with HoN Reborn logged separately if played

primary.version: Original HoN via Project KONGOR or current HoN Reborn route, clearly separated
primary.why: Official Heroes of Newerth servers shut down in 2022. The game remains playable only through community preservation such as Project KONGOR and through the newer Heroes of Newerth: Reborn relaunch, which is a distinct remaster/revival route. The archive must record which route is used.
primary.how_to_play: Document the historical official client/server state, then use Project KONGOR for classic-preservation play or HoN Reborn if documenting the official revival. Record route, launcher, build/date, server, account, hero roster, matchmaking, monetization, mods, and legal/preservation caveats.

secondary.what_to_play: Document from historical sources only unless preserved access exists.
Use separately if documenting the revived version.
